title: WordCamp US 2026 – Recap from Phoenix
content:
Did you know… 🤓

…WordCamp US 2026 in Phoenix drew over 1,100 attendees, with 425 people joining Contributor Day?

WordPress 7.1 launched during the closing ceremony, Phoenix declared it “WordPress Day”, and Matt Mullenweg reminded everyone: “Tech needs to be simpler.”

Next up: WordCamp Asia 2027 in Penang and WordCamp Europe 2027 in Málaga.
